name: Zakera men Waraq
overview: A group of Gulf youth studying in (Europe), between which a friendship begins by virtue of alienation, and this relationship lasts for a long time, until one of them is subjected to an attempt to exploit some gangs, and events continue that reveal the fact that Western societies deal with expatriate youth, especially the Gulf, because of false beliefs that the Gulf society is rich and rich, and its youth did not attend to learn, but came for entertainment and fun only, and events continue.
